scope: Offline V9 diagnostic only; no capacity or acceptance inference. Original report verdict is retained below. Inputs streamed once after operator-confirmed completion.
limits: Anonymous actor aliases and numeric connection IDs are identity evidence only; connection IDs never establish queue/gate/network causality.

No client trace ID is recorded. A unique-record-match means exactly one complete candidate fits recipient/target/position within a 30-second producer window; it is not cryptographic packet identity. Repeated packets remain candidates.

serverTraceID groups are sorted by Instant elapsedUs, never stderr line order. producerUnixMs is event creation wall clock; estimated sent wall time assumes stable system clock and has millisecond quantization.
sent is send/flush return, not client receive. Client receive after estimated sent combines network, client processing, and clock uncertainty; it cannot isolate network delay.
Owner boundary detection requires retained observer selfTransform on same map; missing initial positions or multiple crossings produce unknown/candidates.
Fatal discovery is the first recorded coverage ghost/missing/loss; a poll does not record the per-pair grace timer start.
Final remove means final retained receipt within fatal +/-15 seconds, not proof none occurs outside the window.
Raw samples and non-whitelisted stderr content are never copied or printed. Finite retention caps can make analysis incomplete.
